title: Compiler as a facade
purpose: Explain Compiler orchestrates scanning parsing tree and code generation; preserve related class families.
requiredChecks: Compiler exposes Compile(input, output) and coordinates Scanner, Parser, ProgramNodeBuilder, CodeGenerator.
RISCCodeGenerator and StackMachineCodeGenerator are CodeGenerator implementations; StatementNode, ExpressionNode, VariableNode are ProgramNode specializations.
Token, Symbol and Stream/BytecodeStream supporting types appear without reversing inheritance.
